title: Sangli court denies anticipatory bail to filmmaker Palash Muchhal in SC/ST case
description: A Sangli court has rejected the anticipatory bail plea of filmmaker Palash Muchhal, who is facing allegations of casteist abuse and cheating in a case registered under the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 and the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 [Palash Muchhal v. State of Maharashtra & Anr].Additional Sessions Judge VD Nimbalkar passed the order on July 10, rejecting Muchhal's plea. The FIR against Muchhal was lodged by on a complaint by one Vidnyan on
